description: REPLACES a draft's entire message — the Gmail API has no partial draft edit, so omitted fields are dropped, not kept. Read the current content with get_draft first, then pass the complete new state (recipients, subject, body, and thread_id/in_reply_to for reply drafts). The draft id stays the same; the underlying message id changes. Returns the updated draft.

body_html.description: HTML body (multipart/alternative when body_text is also set).

draft_id.description: The draft id from list_drafts or create_draft output.

in_reply_to.description: RFC Message-ID of the message being replied to (headers.messageId from get_message).

references.description: Explicit References header chain (defaults to in_reply_to).

thread_id.description: Make it a reply draft in this thread (pair with in_reply_to and a matching subject).

name: update_draft
title: Update a draft
